# Head-to-Head — vs. MDPLIB Best-Known — Tables

The tables behind the [MDPLIB comparison](tier3.md). Gaps are in percent below the best-known value of the pairing (negative = above it); `max-div` cells aggregate over the group's instances at the quoted budget.

## I. Gap to the best-known value

Each row gives, per group, the mean and the worst gap over instances of `max-div`'s median over seeds, for both series at 1 s and 60 s.

--8<-- "docs/benchmarks/third_party/head_to_head/results/tier3_gaps.md"

## II. Matched, exceeded and below at 60 s

Each row counts, per group, on how many instances `max-div`'s best value over seeds and both series at 60 s exceeds, matches or falls below the best-known value. A value within 0.01 % of the reference counts as a match.

--8<-- "docs/benchmarks/third_party/head_to_head/results/tier3_counts.md"

## III. Entrants

Each row gives, per group, each entrant's mean gap over the group's instances and seeds.

--8<-- "docs/benchmarks/third_party/head_to_head/results/tier3_entrants.md"
